Class AtomicInspectionRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.AtomicInspectionRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class AtomicInspectionRenderer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Detailed examiner renderer.

Shared sphere mesh, streamed instance transforms, no world renderer dependency.

    • beginExport

      public AtomicInspectionRenderer.ExportCursor beginExport(int width, int height, MoleculeCamera camera, int focusedAtom, long animationNanos, float automaticYaw)
      Initializes an export cursor for rendering frozen frames during media export.

      An isolated export renderer holds one frozen frame while bounded draw ranges finish.

      Parameters:
      width - viewport width
      height - viewport height
      camera - molecule camera
      focusedAtom - focused atom index
      animationNanos - animation time in nanoseconds
      automaticYaw - automatic yaw angle
      Returns:
      a new AtomicInspectionRenderer.ExportCursor
